changelog.changes: Fix BtnApply re-enabling bug: When opening adapter settings or switching DNS profile cards, cancel pending auto-close countdown immediately and re-enable Apply button, allowing continuous profile switching without restarting application; ensure strictly single versioned installer on Desktop.

1) English default installer with silent zero-popup install and auto-launch; 2) Vibrant neon illumination for active/selected card icon circle and border; 3) Language persistence in registry with English default; 4) Complete EN, RU, CS translations for footer GitHub link tooltip; 5) 10-second interactive countdown with Open Adapter Settings button.
Fix BtnApply template namescope bug: BtnApply content set via ContentPresenter instead of inaccessible internal TextBlock, eliminating RuntimeException property Text not found.

1) Single file in Program Files (removed duplicate versioned .cmd); 2) Custom red uninstaller icon with embedded Win32 resource; 3) Compact single-line header with Windows subtitle, removed section title, auto-height window without scroll; 4) Fixed Update button: runs synchronously on UI thread, does not close if up to date; 5) Strict 6-card order: AdGuard, Family AdGuard, Google+Cloudflare, Quad9, Yandex, ISP DHCP.

Rollback to rock-solid stable v004 engine: triple-engine DNS application (WMI SetDNSServerSearchOrder + NetTCPIP + Netsh), clean WPF UI without ThreadPool issues, pure UTF-8 CRLF without BOM, 100% verified error-free execution.

ROOT-CAUSE FIX: DNS apply and Update actions ran in [ThreadPool]::QueueUserWorkItem PowerShell scriptblocks which have no runspace, so DNS was never written and Update crashed/closed the app. Now everything runs on the UI thread with live refresh. DNS engine writes Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\{GUID}\NameServer (exactly what the IPv4 dialog shows) + WMI + netsh validate=no + NetTCPIP (v4+v6 in one call), then verifies by read-back; on failure shows red error and stays open; log at %TEMP%\GIN-DNS-Switch.log.

Compact UI: single-line header 'Умный переключатель DNS' + RU/EN/CS, removed section title and ScrollViewer, window auto-height (SizeToContent) so all 6 cards fit without scrolling; new card order: AdGuard, Family AdGuard, Google+Cloudflare, Quad9, Yandex, ISP DHCP.

Critical Reliability & Architecture Release v004: 1) Rewrote DNS applying engine to Triple-Engine architecture (WMI SetDNSServerSearchOrder + NetTCPIP Set-DnsClientServerAddress + Netsh direct interface bind) ensuring 100% reliable DNS writes on USB Realtek GbE, PCI, and Wi-Fi adapters; 2) Enforced in-process PowerShell UAC Administrator role check; 3) Upgraded Update Button logic: checks version.json, displays persistent green checkmark '✔ У вас последняя версия (v004)' without closing if already up-to-date; 4) Replaced Uninstall.cmd with native compiled Uninstall.exe (Go self-elevating temp-spawning uninstaller like GIN-Wallpaper); 5) Removed redundant Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 profile (consolidated to 6 clean profiles); 6) Enforced versioned installer naming convention: GIN-DNS-Switch_v004_Setup.exe.
